standard_prerequisites: etale ring maps are flat and induce isomorphisms C/I^nC -> C'/I^nC' for all n (Algebra, Lemma algebra-lemma-etale; More on Algebra, Lemma more-algebra-lemma-neighbourhood-isomorphism)

the henselization C^h of the pair (C, IC) as the filtered colimit of etale neighbourhoods C', with C -> C' -> C^h inducing isomorphisms on completions (More on Algebra, Lemmas more-algebra-lemma-henselization and more-algebra-lemma-henselization-Noetherian-pair)
finite type algebras over a Noetherian G-ring are G-rings (More on Algebra, Proposition more-algebra-proposition-finite-type-over-G-ring)
the Artin approximation statement of Smoothing Ring Maps (Lemma smoothing-lemma-henselian-pair): solutions modulo I^N in the completion lift to solutions in the henselization
core_obligations: Prove that for A a Noetherian G-ring with ideal I, finite type A-algebras B and C, any A-algebra map psi : B^wedge -> C^wedge of I-adic completions, and any N >= 1, there exist an etale ring map C -> C' inducing an isomorphism C/IC -> C'/IC' and an A-algebra map B -> C' such that the two maps agree modulo I^N into the common completion (C')^wedge = C^wedge
proof_roadmap: The statement makes sense because etale maps C -> C' induce isomorphisms on all I^n-quotients and hence on completions; moreover C^h is the filtered colimit of the etale C' with completion isomorphisms, so it suffices to lift psi to an A-algebra map B -> C^h congruent modulo I^N.
Write B = A[x_1,...,x_n]/(f_1,...,f_m); the map psi corresponds to elements hat c_i in C^wedge satisfying f_j(hat c) = 0.

C is a Noetherian G-ring, so the Smoothing Ring Maps lemma applies and produces c_i in C^h with f_j(c) = 0 and hat c_i - c_i in I^N C^h; the c_i determine the desired map B -> C^h, hence an etale neighbourhood C' with the required map.
difficulty_reason: H3: an approximation argument that routes the lifting problem through the henselization and applies the Artin-type smoothing lemma.
